```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

source("code/R/utils.R")
source("code/R/visualization.R")
source("code/R/statistics.R")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 15))
```

```{r}
palette_df <- read.csv("metadata/clean/project_palette.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
palette <- setNames(palette_df$color, palette_df$label)
```

# Data Import
```{r}
label_order <- c("Control", "Non-classical FAP", "Classical FAP") %>% rev()
metadata <- read.csv("metadata/clean/core_metadata_with_mean.csv") %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver") %>%
         mutate(phenotype_binary = ifelse(phenotype %in% c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"), "FAP", "Control"),
                phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary, levels = c("Control", "FAP")),
                phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))
```

```{r}
pathways <- read.csv("processed_data/pathways.csv", check.names = F) %>% 
            tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% t() 
pathway_meaning <- read.csv("processed_data/pathway_meanings.csv") %>% select(-X)
pathway_meaning_list <- pathway_meaning$description
names(pathway_meaning_list) <- pathway_meaning$pathway
```

# Analysis
## Data overview using PCA
```{r}
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(sample_id %in% rownames(pathways)) 
df <- metadata %>% left_join(pathways %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")
```

```{r}
results <- get_pca(pathways, 2, center = T)
eig_vals <- results[[1]]
pca_df <- results[[2]] %>% left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")
loadings <- results[[3]]
plot_pca(pca_df, 1,2, results[[1]], color_var = "phenotype") + scale_color_manual(values = palette) 
```
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height = 5}
wilcox_test_by_pair(pca_df, "phenotype", "PC1 ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% add_significance()
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = phenotype, y = PC1, color = phenotype)) + 
  plot_box_and_jitter(palette, 15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) + 
  labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "PCA Axis 1", title = "PCA of Pathway Abundances") 
```



```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height = 4}
regressors <- c("bmi", "age", "gender", "batch")

ggdata <- pca_df %>% select(all_of(c(regressors, "PC1", "phenotype_binary"))) %>% create_dummy_vars(regressors)
new_regressors <- lapply(regressors, function(x) grep(paste0("^",x), colnames(ggdata), value = T)) %>% unlist()
results <- test_wilcox_residuals(ggdata, new_regressors,"PC1", "phenotype_binary")

print(paste("Wilcoxon test p-value:", round(results[[1]],6)))
results[[2]] + scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(x = "Phenotype") + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FAP", "Control"))
```


```{r}
top_pcs <- loadings %>% arrange(desc(PC1)) %>% # In this data PC1 separated the samples by phenotype
          left_join(pathway_meaning, by = "pathway")
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height = 6}
min_val_to_preset <- 0.1

p_pos <- ggplot(top_pcs %>% filter(PC1  > min_val_to_preset), aes(x = reorder(description, PC1), y = PC1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = palette["Control"]) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "PC1 Loading", subtitle = "Positive loadings") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

p_neg <- ggplot(top_pcs %>% filter(PC1 < -min_val_to_preset), aes(x = reorder(description, PC1), y = PC1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = palette["FAP"]) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "PC1 Loading", subtitle = "Negative loadings") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
p_neg + p_pos  
```



```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
target_comp <- top_pcs %>% tail(9) %>%  pull(pathway)
plot_list = list()
for (comp in target_comp){
  ggp <- ggplot(df , aes(x = phenotype, y = !!as.symbol(comp), color = phenotype, fill = phenotype)) + 
       plot_box_and_jitter(palette, 10) + 
       labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "Pathway Abundance", subtitle = pathway_meaning_list[[comp]]) 
  plot_list <- c(plot_list, list(ggp))
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 3)
```
```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
target_comp <- top_pcs %>% head(9) %>%  pull(pathway)
plot_list = list()
for (comp in target_comp){
  ggp <- ggplot(df , aes(x = phenotype, y = !!as.symbol(comp), color = phenotype, fill = phenotype)) + 
       plot_box_and_jitter(palette, 10) + 
       labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "Pathway Abundance", subtitle = pathway_meaning_list[[comp]]) 
  plot_list <- c(plot_list, list(ggp))
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 3)
```
